description: A WPF ClickOnce deployment crashes with `DllNotFoundException` because WebView2Loader.dll is not installed with the app, based on https://stackoverflow.com/questions/71265161/webview2-works-in-debug-but-not-when-published-with-clickonce.
prompt:
WebView2 works when I debug the WPF app, but the ClickOnce-installed app crashes as soon as the browser view opens. I can see `WebView2Loader.dll` next to the publish output, but it is not in the final install folder.

```
Exception Info: System.DllNotFoundException: Dll was not found.
   at Microsoft.Web.WebView2.Core.CoreWebView2Environment.CreateCoreWebView2EnvironmentWithOptions(...)
   at Microsoft.Web.WebView2.Core.CoreWebView2Environment.CreateAsync(...)
```
